top_creatures.label: Pack-call guardian
top_creatures.why: A mob in combat calls same-type pack mobs in its zone, and they take its target. As written the call never starts (see defect 1).
top_creatures.keep: Only same-type mobs answer; the responders take the caller's target; a cooldown after a response.
top_creatures.change: Responders need a radius and line-of-sight check (MobAI.java line 567 has none); fix the cooldown check; log the call to the zone, not the chat.

top_creatures.label: Race-scaled humanoid
top_creatures.why: The same humanoid reads at different sizes by race: Elf male 1.4, Dwarf male 0.8, CSR female 0.66.
top_creatures.keep: A size per race row and a size per sex.
top_creatures.change: Our scale range is fixed for 375-wide readability.

top_creatures.label: Fast brute
top_creatures.why: A heavy creature whose speed row (MINOTAUR, first two values 6.63 and 15.95) is above the standard row (6.19 and 13.97).
top_creatures.keep: A speed row per body type.
top_creatures.change: Our brute gets a readable wind-up, not only speed.

top_creatures.label: Leader-follower guard
top_creatures.why: Guard minions declare a captain type as their helper type, so a captain and its followers are one unit.
top_creatures.keep: The follower is declared by its leader type.
top_creatures.change: The follow and target rule is ours (the code was not read).

top_creatures.label: Wall archer
top_creatures.why: A static ranged post that does not roam but is aggressive (GuardWallArcher: can roam false, aggressive true).
top_creatures.keep: A post that never moves and shoots.
top_creatures.change: Its line of fire is drawn on the ground so a phone player can read it.

top_creatures.label: Wimpy support
top_creatures.why: A wimpy mob skips the attack step, so it is a support role (MobAI.java line 1153).
top_creatures.change: Our support gives a heal or buff, not only a call.

top_creatures.label: Epic caster that answers calls
top_creatures.why: SpellAggroHelpeeEpic responds to calls and is a caster; it joins a pack fight when called.
top_creatures.keep: Caster plus responder as one type.
top_creatures.change: The response is a cast with a windup and a sound.

top_creatures.label: Shade (tag only)
top_creatures.why: A shadow-kin tag used for race rows (SHADEMALE and SHADEFEMALE, scale 1). Tag only; no stats or looks were read.
top_creatures.keep: The tag as a faction label.
top_creatures.change: Our shade look is our own design, not a copy of any look.

looks.label: Siege phase clock
looks.technique: One timestamp derives three phases: challenge if there is no live date, war after it, standoff between (Bane.java lines 355-365). ERRANT and CEASEFIRE are defined but not referenced.

looks.label: Hot zone rotation
looks.technique: One bonus zone at a time; set flag (ZoneManager.java line 161); eligible zones have a node list, are not sea floor, have not been hot this cycle (line 263), and meet a level floor (line 268); a reset clears the flags (lines 132-133).

looks.label: Spire cap per tree rank
looks.technique: Maximum spires by rank: 0 for ranks 0-2, 1 for 3-4, 2 for 5-6, 3 for 7-8 (Blueprint.java lines 96-112).

looks.label: Spire removal on demotion
looks.technique: Excess spires are disabled and their rank set to -1 (Building.java lines 664-675). The comment says random; the code takes list item 0 (line 669).

looks.label: Race scale on the body
looks.technique: A race scale multiplies a computed body scale (PlayerCharacter.java lines 5390-5394).

looks.label: Corpse cleanup job
looks.technique: A corpse schedules a removal job at creation with a 15-minute timer (Corpse.java makeCorpse lines 88-100; MBServerStatics.java line 329).

looks.label: Shrine and spire kinds as looks
looks.technique: Shrines (34 kinds) and spires (21 kinds) are typed rows with numeric ids and flags; their visual meaning was not read.

originals.name: Pack Call
originals.idea: A mob in combat calls same-type pack members in its zone, and they join its target.
originals.keep: Same-type answer and one call per cooldown.
originals.change: Radius and line-of-sight check; fixed cooldown; engine-owned (hate list, parity row 4).

originals.name: Siege Clock
originals.idea: One timestamp gives challenge, standoff and war phases for a zone event.
originals.change: Each phase has a rules table; the two unused phases are used or dropped.

originals.name: Rank Cap Towers
originals.idea: A city rank caps the towers it may hold; demotion removes the excess.
originals.keep: The cap per rank and removal of the excess.
originals.change: The removal rule is chosen on purpose (newest or oldest) and the owner is told.

originals.name: Rotating Bonus Zone
originals.idea: One bonus zone at a time, with a level floor and no repeat within a cycle.
originals.keep: Single zone, level floor, no repeat.
originals.change: Rotation runs on the server tick and feeds zone population (parity row 23).

originals.name: Race Scale Row
originals.idea: Each race row sets a size and a speed group for the body.
originals.keep: A row per race with scale and speed.
originals.change: Our hero scales are data and limited for 375-wide readability.

originals.name: Captain and Minions
originals.idea: A captain with class-mixed followers (melee, archer, mage), each follower declaring its leader.
originals.change: Minions take the captain's target only when it is in range.

defects: Call for help never starts (MobAI.java lines 554-557): the stored time is set to now when zero, and line 557 returns when the stored time is below now, so the first call returns. Only a response (line 576) moves the stored time forward, and after it passes nothing resets it. Fix: return only while the cooldown runs, start at zero, set now plus 60 s on a response.
Responders have no range check (MobAI.java line 566-567 loops over the whole zone set). Fix: radius and line-of-sight check.
No null check on the zone (MobAI.java line 564). Fix: check and return.
Spire removal takes list item 0 while the comment says random (Building.java lines 669-670). Fix: pick the rule on purpose.
ERRANT and CEASEFIRE siege phases have no reference outside the enum (grep). Fix: use or drop.
Other defect reported by AU028 (not re-read): hot-zone roll bound in LootManager.java lines 266-286 can pass its cap at high level. Fix: clamp min to max before the roll.
